activity.notes: Edigu was a dominant emir of the late Golden Horde and under him the Manghit Yurt began separating into the political formation later known as the Nogai Horde. Kazakhstan's historical portal describes him as sovereign ruler for about fifteen years, 1396-1411, while noting that full Nogai independence came only in the mid-fifteenth century. ATLAS therefore avoids anachronistically presenting a fully independent Nogai Horde in 1396.
